#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Inspect budget.xlsx and calculate total expenses across all categories."""
import pandas as pd

PATH = "budget.xlsx"

sheets = pd.read_excel(PATH, sheet_name=None)
print("SHEETS:", list(sheets.keys()))

for name, df in sheets.items():
    print(f"\n--- Sheet: {name} (shape={df.shape}) ---")
    print("COLUMNS:", list(df.columns))
    print(df.to_string(index=False))
    print("DTYPES:\n", df.dtypes.to_string())

import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"

xl = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print("SHEETS:", xl.sheet_names)

for name in xl.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=name, header=None)
    print(f"\n=== SHEET {name!r} shape={df.shape} ===")
    with pd.option_context("display.max_rows", None, "display.max_columns", None, "display.width", 300):
        print(df.to_string())
